note: Triennial election of Castlereagh Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Six of the nine seats were contested. Of the six sitting official Unionists who faced contests only three held their seats: Castlereagh went to Labour, Ballyhackamore to the Tenants' Association and Ballycultra to an unofficial Unionist. The three uncontested divisions (Ballymiscaw, Craigavad, Dundonald) are from the returning officer's notice of result (Belfast Telegraph, 7 June 1961, p. 16), which also confirms the six contests (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Sole candidate; no poll (no votes in the notice). Returned unopposed.
